# hvrg_routing (Resource)

The routing records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `class` (String) the retention class stamped, default or a class of the signal in retention
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `match` (Dynamic) what a row must carry to match: service, environment, severity or attribute
- `signal` (String) logs, metrics or traces

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) false skips the rule
- `name` (String) display name
- `owner_id` (String) owning organization
- `priority` (Number) lower runs first
